headline: Factory and periphery verified with recognized audits; UniswapV3Pool Etherscan verification unconfirmed in this run per official documentation

findings.text: UniswapV3Factory (0x1F98431c8aD98523631AE4a59f267346ea31F984, Ethereum) is verified on Etherscan per DeFiPunkd API (abiSource=etherscan, verified=true, proxy=null). Official Uniswap v3-periphery deploys.md (mirrored in multiple forks) explicitly states 'The source code is verified with Etherscan on all networks, for all contracts except UniswapV3Pool.' UniswapV3Pool (0xC36442b4a4522E871399CD717aBDD847Ab11FE88) was flagged as unverified in the initial deployment documentation. DeFiPunkd ABI fetch for the pool contract returned permission-denied in this run, so current verification status could not be confirmed on-chain.

Public source repos exist at https://github.com/Uniswap/v3-core and https://github.com/Uniswap/v3-periphery. The official deploys.md maps UniswapV3Factory at 0x1F98431c8aD98523631AE4a59f267346ea31F984 to github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v3-core/blob/v1.0.0/contracts/UniswapV3Factory.sol. GitHub was inaccessible for direct fetch in this run, so no commit SHA was independently pinned.

Trail of Bits audited Uniswap V3 core contracts in March 2021 (report at https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v3-core/blob/main/audits/tob/audit.pdf). ABDK Consulting performed a general security review and published an audit report for V3 core contracts in March 2021 prior to launch (report at https://abdk.consulting/ABDK_UniswapV3_v1.pdf). The pinned audit_links also include a ConsenSys 2018-12 audit which covers Uniswap V1/V2 era, predating V3. The V3 core contracts are immutable post-deployment, so the 2021 audits remain current against deployed bytecode for core contracts.

Trail of Bits and ABDK Consulting are both broadly recognized Solidity audit firms. Trail of Bits is listed in the rubric's recognized firms. ABDK Consulting has an established audit history for Uniswap contracts confirmed via public GitHub and docs.uniswap.org security page.

UniswapV3Factory and UniswapV3Pool are immutable (no upgradeable proxy on factory per DeFiPunkd API, proxy=null). Post-audit drift is structurally impossible for deployed immutable core contracts. The NonfungibleTokenPositionDescriptor is behind a TransparentUpgradeableProxy (0xEe6A57eC80ea46401049E92587E52f5Ec1c24785), and any implementation upgrade could introduce drift; the proxy contract's implementation verification was flagged as needing Etherscan verification in v3-periphery GitHub issue #128 (opened May 2021). Current implementation verification status not confirmed in this run.

UniswapV3Factory is not a proxy (proxy=null confirmed on-chain via DeFiPunkd API). For the NonfungibleTokenPositionDescriptor proxy (0xEe6A57eC80ea46401049E92587E52f5Ec1c24785), v3-periphery GitHub issue #128 records it as a TransparentUpgradeableProxy that needed Etherscan verification as of May 2021. Implementation contract behind this proxy could not be fetched or verified in this run.

steelman.red: The official Uniswap v3-periphery deploys.md explicitly states UniswapV3Pool is not Etherscan-verified, and the TransparentUpgradeableProxy for NonfungibleTokenPositionDescriptor had an open verification issue at launch; if these remain unresolved, a core fund-custody contract (pool) has unverified bytecode.
steelman.orange: Most contracts (factory, routers, periphery) are Etherscan-verified with recognized-firm audits, but UniswapV3Pool's Etherscan verification was explicitly flagged as incomplete in official documentation and could not be confirmed in this run, and the proxy wrapper's implementation verification is also uncertain.
steelman.green: UniswapV3 core contracts are immutable with two pre-launch audits from Trail of Bits and ABDK (both recognized firms), factory is confirmed verified on-chain, public canonical GitHub repos exist, and pool bytecode is deterministically derivable from public init code hash even without direct Etherscan verification.

rationale.verdict: Choosing orange because the official Uniswap v3-periphery deploys.md explicitly states UniswapV3Pool is not Etherscan-verified (with 'we are working on getting UniswapV3Pool contract verified'), and this pool contract's current on-chain verification status could not be confirmed in this run due to fetch failures; additionally, the TransparentUpgradeableProxy for NFTPositionDescriptor had an open Etherscan verification issue as of launch. The factory is confirmed verified with recognized-firm audits, placing this above red, but the pool verification gap and proxy implementation uncertainty prevent a green grade.

protocol_metadata.about: Uniswap V3 is a decentralized exchange protocol that allows users to swap ERC-20 tokens and provide concentrated liquidity within custom price ranges. Liquidity providers deposit token pairs into discrete pools identified by fee tier, receiving NFT position receipts (NonfungiblePositionManager) representing their range-bound liquidity. The protocol's distinctive mechanism is concentrated liquidity, which enables LPs to allocate capital to specific price intervals, increasing capital efficiency compared to uniform distribution. Core contracts (factory, pools) are immutable; only the NFT position descriptor peripheral contract uses a transparent upgradeable proxy.
